name: us-lobbying-mcp-server
description: Search US lobbying disclosures and foreign-agent registrations via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search US lobbying disclosures and foreign-agent registrations via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Search federal lobbying registrations and activity reports from the Senate's LDA API, resolve client relationship IDs before analyzing selected years, inspect filing-specific lobbyist positions, and retrieve complete LD-203 contribution reports. Analytical results keep income and expenses separate, retain amendment-selection decisions, and treat issue amounts as overlapping whole-filing associations. Search official daily FARA registrant and foreign-principal XML snapshots, then fetch a chosen registration's live principal, short-form, or document collection. Follow acquisition and output continuations for complete records; optional DuckDB tables support local SQL and the opt-in drop tool removes staged tables. No API key is required. Disclosure records do not establish wrongdoing or policy influence.
